selection: rank 1 is the single highest May-June return at 2bp with >=30 validation trades; PEER/B1 and PCA3/B2 15m/4h are fixed controls
funding: included from /fapi/v1/fundingRate markPrice and fundingRate; settlement cashflow is reported separately
all_in_cost_definition: one-way bps charged on net aggregate order turnover; no separate slippage
